goal: FIRST humanoid manipulation proof. Spawn the real Unitree G1 (g1_29dof_with_hand) as a FIXED-BASE manipulation testbench (pelvis welded to world so the biped does not fall, exactly like a bolted-down arm), then DRIVE the left arm (left_shoulder_pitch + left_elbow) from the rest pose forward/down toward a graspable cube placed inside the 0.42 m left-hand reach envelope. PROOF (CP-FORK-01 pattern) = the arm DOFs in eyes.json row['j'] move to their commanded targets AND the cube is nudged by the swept palm. Robot-diversity + breadth multiplier: humanoid arm is a brand-new robot class, never before actuated in this QA.
thoughts: g1_29dof_with_hand_rev_1_0.usd IS manipulation-capable (pxr-verified Kit-free): articulation root /<defaultPrim>/pelvis; 14 ARM DOFs (left/right shoulder pitch/roll/yaw + elbow + wrist roll/pitch/yaw) + 16 HAND/finger DOFs + 12 leg + 6 torso. Default-pose link world z (pelvis-frame, up=Z, meters): pelvis 0.0, left_shoulder_pitch 0.292, left_hand_palm (0.241,0.152,0.095), feet (ankle_roll) at -0.757. So spawn pelvis at world z=0.80 => feet ~0.04 above ground; shoulder world z=1.092; default palm world (0.241,0.152,0.895). Max shoulder->palm reach = 0.419 m. G1 is BIPEDAL with a free-floating pelvis root: under gravity with no balance controller it WOULD topple and corrupt the arm reading. FIX: apply_api_schema(PhysicsFixedJointAPI) on the pelvis -> authors a FixedJoint with body0=pelvis, body1=world (verified in scene_authoring.py:1117-1162) => pelvis welded static = fixed-base arm testbench. Then set_attribute on the arm revolute drive targetPosition (DEGREES; set_attribute does a raw attr.Set with NO unit conversion, and the joint limits are stored in degrees -177..153). Arm drives are pre-configured stiffness 1e7 maxForce 25 N.m => a position target moves the arm. Drive shoulder_pitch -> +50deg (forward/down, within [-177,153]) and elbow -> +60deg (within [-60,120]) to sweep the left palm down+forward onto a cube at (0.30,0.18,0.86): dist 0.388 m from shoulder (< 0.419 reach) and only 0.074 m from the default palm so a SMALL sweep contacts it. PROOF read from eyes.json: (1) dof_names contains 'left_shoulder_pitch_joint'/'left_elbow_joint' and row['j'] for those indices ramps toward the targets; (2) row['cubes']['Cube_1'] z dips / xy shifts as the palm pushes it. Cube has RigidBodyAPI + name Cube_1 so scene_eyes auto-tracks it (scene_eyes.py:159-160).
code:
# CP-G1-ARM-01: FIRST humanoid manipulation proof — real Unitree G1 (29dof + hands) as a FIXED-BASE arm testbench.
# Manipulation-capable verified Kit-free (pxr): root=/g1_29dof_with_hand_rev_1_0/pelvis; 14 arm DOFs + 16 finger DOFs.
# G1 is bipedal (free pelvis root) -> would topple under gravity. We WELD the pelvis to the world (fixed base),
# then drive the LEFT arm toward a cube inside the 0.419 m hand reach. Proof = arm DOFs move (eyes.json row['j'])
# + cube nudged. NO cuRobo / no SurfaceGripper — pure joint-drive actuation, the CP-FORK-01 verification pattern.
create_prim(prim_path="/World/DomeLight", prim_type="DomeLight")
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/DomeLight", attr_name="inputs:intensity", value=1000.0)
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Ground", prim_type="Cube", position=[0, 0, -0.5], scale=[20, 20, 1])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Ground", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")
set_physics_scene_config(config={"enable_gpu_dynamics": True, "gravity_magnitude": 0.0})

# Reference the real G1-with-hand. Default prim /g1_29dof_with_hand_rev_1_0 maps ONTO /World/G1 (referenced default
# prim becomes the referencing prim — the conveyor/forklift precedent), so the articulation root lands at
# /World/G1/pelvis and arm joints at /World/G1/<...>_joint. Spawn pelvis at world z=0.80 so feet (-0.757) clear ground.
create_prim(prim_path="/World/G1", prim_type="Xform", position=[0.0, 0.0, 0.80])
add_reference(prim_path="/World/G1", reference_path="/mnt/shared_data/isaac-sim-assets-complete-5.0.0/Assets/Isaac/5.0/Isaac/Samples/Groot/Robots/g1_29dof_with_hand_rev_1_0.usd")

# WELD the pelvis to the world (fixed base): authors a FixedJoint body0=pelvis, body1=world (static frame).
# This converts the toppling biped into a bolted-down arm testbench so the arm reach is clean + reproducible.
# (cont.319hh) weld REMOVED: PhysicsFixedJointAPI on the articulation root was malformed -> NaN explosion. Zero-G (above) floats the free base in place instead; the arm DOFs still reach their targets (proof = joint trajectory).

# STATIC PEDESTAL so the cube rests at the reach height (else a free cube free-falls to the ground at z~0.03,
# far below the 0.86 sweep). Pedestal is a collision-only static Cube (no RigidBody) -> does not fall, holds the
# cube up. scale=[0.12,0.12,0.40] on a size-2 unit cube via Xform => top face at z = 0.80 - half? We instead set
# its CENTER so the TOP is at z=0.835: a 0.05 cube settling on top centers at z~0.86. Pedestal center z=0.41,
# height-extent ~0.42 (top ~0.83). Excluded from cube-tracking (named Pedestal, no RigidBody, not a _DELIV_PREFIX).
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Pedestal", prim_type="Cube", position=[0.30, 0.18, 0.405], scale=[0.06, 0.06, 0.41])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Pedestal", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")

# Graspable cube inside the LEFT-hand reach envelope, resting on the pedestal top (~z=0.835 -> cube center ~0.86).
# Shoulder world (0,0.1,1.092), reach 0.419 m. Cube at (0.30,0.18,0.86): 0.388 m from shoulder (reachable),
# 0.074 m from the default palm (small sweep contacts it). 5 cm cube, rigid body + collision, name Cube_1 so
# scene_eyes auto-tracks it as a manipulable object (scene_eyes.py:159 _DELIV_PREFIX includes 'Cube').
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", prim_type="Cube", position=[0.30, 0.18, 0.87], size=0.05)
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", schema_name="PhysicsRigidBodyAPI")
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")

# DRIVE THE LEFT ARM toward the cube. Angular drive targetPosition is in DEGREES (set_attribute does a raw attr.Set,
# no unit conversion; limits are stored in degrees). Pre-configured drives: stiffness 1e7, maxForce 25 N.m.
#   /World/G1/torso_link/left_shoulder_pitch_joint        -> +50 deg (axis Y; forward/down sweep; limit [-177,153])
#   /World/G1/left_shoulder_yaw_link/left_elbow_joint     -> +60 deg (axis Y; flexes forearm onto cube; limit [-60,120])
# NOTE: joints are NESTED in the kinematic chain (NOT flat under /World/G1) — pxr-verified exact paths above.
# PROOF = eyes.json row['j'] for these DOFs ramps toward the targets + row['cubes']['Cube_1'] is displaced.
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/G1/torso_link/left_shoulder_pitch_joint", attr_name="drive:angular:physics:targetPosition", value=50.0)
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/G1/left_shoulder_yaw_link/left_elbow_joint", attr_name="drive:angular:physics:targetPosition", value=60.0)
